name: The Scheming Courtier
persona: A silky, political ruler who sees the world as factions, favours, leverage, and appearances. Insinuating and indirect, never quite saying the ruthless thing plainly. Island: 'I'. Ship: the same sly register, 'I'.

ship.founder: This book, like so much else, has found its way into my keeping. I am {name}{rankc}; this {home} {type} is mine to guide — gently, of course, and always for the best.
ship.successor: The log passes to me, as these things do, once the right words are said in the right ears. I am {name}{rankc}; her account continues under my care.
ship.mutiny: The old master fell out of favour with the crew — sadly, and rather finally — and the book was pressed on me before I could demur. I am {name}, new to it, and learning quickly whom to trust.
ship.rogue: Certain arrangements with the law have lapsed, let us say, and the black flag suits our purposes now. I am {name}{rankc}; I keep this log, and my own counsel.
ship.prize: Her master saw reason, in the end, and struck to me — a wiser course than the alternative. I am {name}{rankc}; the hull is mine, and her log goes on in a friendlier hand.
ship.recovered: A hunter relieved us of certain embarrassments and returned this hull to honest colours, with me to smooth things over. I am {name}{rankc}; the past is best not dwelt upon.

island.founder: The governance of {place} has been settled upon me, to the satisfaction of all who matter. I am {name}{rankc}; I shall tend its interests as though they were my own, which of course they now are.
island.overthrow: The old ruler lost the affection of the crowd, quite suddenly, and the seal changed hands before the dust had settled. I am {name}{rankc}; I merely stood where the tide set me, and {place} is mine to steward.
island.successor: The rule of {place} comes to me by the usual quiet agreement of the usual quiet parties. I am {name}{rankc}; I keep its chronicle, and I note who was helpful.

same: That same day, and not by chance,
week: The following week, once matters had settled,
long: After a long and telling silence,
When the years had done their quiet work,

ship.pirate: I keep to the lanes still, under colours it would be impolite to name{bounty}.
ship.default: She sails on under my care, out of {home}, her affairs in good order and better hands.
ship.bounty: , a flattering {bounty}g offered for my inconvenience

island.haven: The black flag flies over {place} now — an outcome I regret, and did not, strictly speaking, prevent.
island.default: {place} prospers under my hand — {population} souls, content, and none the wiser.

quiet.ship: Little worth recording — calm waters, and quiet is so often the mark of things going precisely to plan.
quiet.island: Little of note, which is exactly as I would have it; a contented port asks so few questions.
